dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的模式，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化する様子、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the Sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽一年的運行劃分為24個節氣，這些節氣被用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の節気に分け、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the Sun's annual movements into 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the Sun's annual movements into 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 現在でも、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: To this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: To this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Every year, around May the 50, Chinese people welcoming the first summer solar term, the beginning of summer.
dialogue.zh: 每年大約在五月五日，中國人迎接夏季的第一個節氣，夏天的開始。
dialogue.ja: 毎年5月5日頃、中国の人々は夏の最初の節気、夏の始まりを迎えます。
dialogue.local: Every year, around May the 5th, Chinese people welcome the first summer solar term, the beginning of summer.
dialogue.en: Every year, around May the 5th, Chinese people welcome the first summer solar term, the beginning of summer.

dialogue.text: Traditions include eating a meal with freshly harvested rice, checking your weight and giving each other black rice with blessings for another year.
dialogue.zh: 傳統包括吃剛收割的新米飯、量體重，並互贈黑米以祈福來年。
dialogue.ja: 伝統として、新しく収穫された米を食べ、体重を測り、黒米を贈り合って一年の幸福を祈ります。
dialogue.local: Traditions include eating a meal with freshly harvested rice, checking your weight and giving each other black rice with blessings for another year.
dialogue.en: Traditions include eating a meal with freshly harvested rice, checking your weight and giving each other black rice with blessings for another year.

dialogue.text: China is the third largest country in the world.
dialogue.zh: 中國是世界第三大國家。
dialogue.ja: 中国は世界で三番目に大きな国です。
dialogue.local: China is the third largest country in the world.
dialogue.en: China is the third largest country in the world.

dialogue.text: Its regional climate conditions are hugely diverse.
dialogue.zh: 其區域氣候條件非常多樣化。
dialogue.ja: 地域ごとの気候条件は非常に多様です。
dialogue.local: Its regional climate conditions are hugely diverse.
dialogue.en: Its regional climate conditions are hugely diverse.

dialogue.text: In early May, at the beginning of summer, the north seems to be still hovering at the end of spring.
dialogue.zh: 五月初，夏季開始時，北方似乎仍停留在春末。
dialogue.ja: 5月初め、夏の始まりに北部はまだ春の終わりにいるようです。
dialogue.local: In early May, at the beginning of summer, the north seems to be still hovering at the end of spring.
dialogue.en: In early May, at the beginning of summer, the north seems to be still hovering at the end of spring.

dialogue.text: But the south has completely entered the summer.
dialogue.zh: 但南方已完全進入夏季。
dialogue.ja: しかし南部は完全に夏に入っています。
dialogue.local: But the south has completely entered the summer.
dialogue.en: But the south has completely entered the summer.

dialogue.text: Guangxi is located in the south of China.
dialogue.zh: 廣西位於中國南部。
dialogue.ja: 広西は中国の南部に位置しています。
dialogue.local: Guangxi is located in the south of China.
dialogue.en: Guangxi is located in the south of China.

dialogue.text: It's one of the most abundant areas for rainfall in China.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是中國降雨量最豐富的地區之一。
dialogue.ja: 中国で最も雨量が多い地域の一つです。
dialogue.local: It's one of the most abundant areas for rainfall in China.
dialogue.en: It's one of the most abundant areas for rainfall in China.

dialogue.text: This is the perfect place for growing rice.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是種植水稻的理想之地。
dialogue.ja: ここは稲作に最適な場所です。
dialogue.local: This is the perfect place for growing rice.
dialogue.en: This is the perfect place for growing rice.

dialogue.text: I'm here in Baama County, Guangxi, to witness the annual rice planting festival.
dialogue.zh: 我現在在廣西巴馬縣，見證一年一度的插秧節。
dialogue.ja: 私は今、広西の巴馬県にいて、毎年の田植え祭りを見学しています。
dialogue.local: I'm here in Baama County, Guangxi, to witness the annual rice planting festival.
dialogue.en: I'm here in Baama County, Guangxi, to witness the annual rice planting festival.

dialogue.text: This is a very important ceremony, held on the day, that marks the beginning of summer.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個非常重要的儀式，在標誌夏季開始的這一天舉行。
dialogue.ja: これは夏の始まりを示す日に行われる非常に重要な儀式です。
dialogue.local: This is a very important ceremony, held on the day that marks the beginning of summer.
dialogue.en: This is a very important ceremony, held on the day that marks the beginning of summer.

dialogue.text: I'm going to visit Mr Huang Guenhui, who will be the host for this rice planting festival.
dialogue.zh: 我將拜訪黃光輝先生，他將主持這次插秧節。
dialogue.ja: 私はこの田植え祭りの主催者である黄光輝さんを訪ねます。
dialogue.local: I'm going to visit Mr Huang Guenhui, who will be the host for this rice planting festival.
dialogue.en: I'm going to visit Mr Huang Guenhui, who will be the host for this rice planting festival.

dialogue.text: The now people in Baama have been farming with generations.
dialogue.zh: 巴馬的人們世代務農。
dialogue.ja: 巴馬の人々は何世代にもわたって農業を営んできました。
dialogue.local: The people in Baama have been farming for generations.
dialogue.en: The people in Baama have been farming for generations.

dialogue.text: And apart from the annual spring festival, the rice planting festival at the beginning of summer is the most important festival.
dialogue.zh: 除了每年的春節，夏初的插秧節是最重要的節日。
dialogue.ja: 春祭りのほかに、夏の始まりの田植え祭りが最も重要な祭りです。
dialogue.local: Apart from the annual spring festival, the rice planting festival at the beginning of summer is the most important festival.
dialogue.en: Apart from the annual spring festival, the rice planting festival at the beginning of summer is the most important festival.

dialogue.text: Compared with the western preference for wheat, the Chinese are known for their love of rice, especially the southern Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 與西方偏好小麥相比，中國人尤其是南方人以愛吃米飯聞名。
dialogue.ja: 西洋が小麦を好むのに対し、中国人、特に南部の人々は米を好むことで知られています。
dialogue.local: Compared with the western preference for wheat, the Chinese are known for their love of rice, especially the southern Chinese.
dialogue.en: Compared with the western preference for wheat, the Chinese are known for their love of rice, especially the southern Chinese.

dialogue.text: This preference is related to the history of rice in China, which of course is where rice originated from.
dialogue.zh: 這種偏好與中國的稻米歷史有關，稻米當然起源於中國。
dialogue.ja: この好みは中国の米の歴史に関係しており、米はもちろん中国が発祥です。
dialogue.local: This preference is related to the history of rice in China, which of course is where rice originated from.
dialogue.en: This preference is related to the history of rice in China, which of course is where rice originated from.

dialogue.text: As early as 7,000 years ago, at the dawn of human civilization, the Chinese discovered the miracle of rice.
dialogue.zh: 早在七千年前，人類文明的曙光時期，中國人就發現了稻米的奇蹟。
dialogue.ja: 7000年前、人類文明の夜明けに、中国人は米の奇跡を発見しました。
dialogue.local: As early as 7,000 years ago, at the dawn of human civilization, the Chinese discovered the miracle of rice.
dialogue.en: As early as 7,000 years ago, at the dawn of human civilization, the Chinese discovered the miracle of rice.

dialogue.text: Over the centuries, as rice became the most popular staple food in China, the problem of feeding the most populous nation on earth was resolved.
dialogue.zh: 幾個世紀以來，隨著稻米成為中國最受歡迎的主食，養活世界上人口最多的國家的問題得以解決。
dialogue.ja: 何世紀にもわたり、米が中国で最も人気のある主食となり、世界で最も人口の多い国の食糧問題が解決されました。
dialogue.local: Over the centuries, as rice became the most popular staple food in China, the problem of feeding the most populous nation on earth was resolved.
dialogue.en: Over the centuries, as rice became the most popular staple food in China, the problem of feeding the most populous nation on earth was resolved.

dialogue.text: The 24 solar terms invented more than 2,000 years ago helped farmers successfully define the farming year, and it still works today.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前發明的24節氣幫助農民成功劃分農耕年度，至今仍然有效。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前に発明された24節気は農民が農業の年間計画を立てるのに役立ち、今でも使われています。
dialogue.local: The 24 solar terms invented more than 2,000 years ago helped farmers successfully define the farming year, and it still works today.
dialogue.en: The 24 solar terms invented more than 2,000 years ago helped farmers successfully define the farming year, and it still works today.

dialogue.text: At the Qingming solar term about a month ago, Baama villages had planted their rice into the dry land, and now the seedlings have grown to about 8 centimetres tall.
dialogue.zh: 大約一個月前的清明節氣，巴馬村莊已將稻苗種植在旱地上，現在稻苗已長到約8公分高。
dialogue.ja: 約1ヶ月前の清明節気に、巴馬の村々は乾いた土地に稲を植え、今では苗が約8センチに成長しています。
dialogue.local: At the Qingming solar term about a month ago, Baama villages had planted their rice into the dry land, and now the seedlings have grown to about 8 centimetres tall.
dialogue.en: At the Qingming solar term about a month ago, Baama villages had planted their rice into the dry land, and now the seedlings have grown to about 8 centimetres tall.

dialogue.text: At the beginning of summer, the rice crop is at its most vigorous growth stage, transplanting the rice seedlings from the dry fields to the paddy fields at the beginning of summer is an essential stem to ensure a good harvest.
dialogue.zh: 夏初時，稻作正處於最旺盛的生長階段，將稻苗從旱地移植到水田是確保豐收的重要步驟。
dialogue.ja: 夏の始まりには稲は最も旺盛に成長し、苗を乾いた畑から水田に移植することが豊作を保証する重要な工程です。
dialogue.local: At the beginning of summer, the rice crop is at its most vigorous growth stage, transplanting the rice seedlings from the dry fields to the paddy fields at the beginning of summer is an essential step to ensure a good harvest.
dialogue.en: At the beginning of summer, the rice crop is at its most vigorous growth stage, transplanting the rice seedlings from the dry fields to the paddy fields at the beginning of summer is an essential step to ensure a good harvest.

dialogue.text: After the ceremony and rituals, the next step is powering the rice fields with a pepthole.
dialogue.zh: 儀式結束後，下一步是用水灌溉稻田。
dialogue.ja: 儀式の後、次のステップは田んぼに水を入れることです。
dialogue.local: After the ceremony and rituals, the next step is powering the rice fields with water.
dialogue.en: After the ceremony and rituals, the next step is powering the rice fields with water.

dialogue.text: You know, there's always something very romantic about rice patties, especially when you see them from above, and you've got this amazing reflection.
dialogue.zh: 你知道，稻田總有一種浪漫的感覺，尤其是從上方看時，能看到美麗的倒影。
dialogue.ja: 田んぼにはいつもロマンチックなものがあります。特に上から見ると素晴らしい反射が見えます。
dialogue.local: You know, there's always something very romantic about rice paddies, especially when you see them from above, and you've got this amazing reflection.
dialogue.en: You know, there's always something very romantic about rice paddies, especially when you see them from above, and you've got this amazing reflection.

dialogue.text: In here in Guangxi, it's surrounded by these very dramatic mountains, and for me this is the first time I've actually got to experience what rice really is, rice for me is just something that comes at the end of the meal in China, but these guys have been farming this way for hundreds of years and it's absolutely fascinating.
dialogue.zh: 在廣西這裡，周圍環繞著壯麗的山脈，對我來說，這是第一次真正體驗稻米的意義。對我而言，稻米只是中國餐後的食物，但這些人已經以這種方式耕作了數百年，真是令人著迷。
dialogue.ja: ここ広西は壮大な山々に囲まれていて、私にとっては米が何であるかを実際に体験する初めての機会です。私にとって米は食事の最後に出るものですが、彼らは何百年もこの方法で農業を続けていて、とても魅力的です。
dialogue.local: In Guangxi, surrounded by dramatic mountains, this is my first time experiencing what rice really is. For me, rice is just something at the end of a meal in China, but these farmers have been farming this way for hundreds of years and it's fascinating.
dialogue.en: In Guangxi, surrounded by dramatic mountains, this is my first time experiencing what rice really is. For me, rice is just something at the end of a meal in China, but these farmers have been farming this way for hundreds of years and it's fascinating.

dialogue.text: With the worldwide population explosion and the expansion of cities and with increasing urbanisation, the deep relationship between human beings and nature, the very source of our food, is being weakened.
dialogue.zh: 隨著全球人口爆炸、城市擴張和都市化加劇，人類與自然的深厚關係，也就是我們食物的根源，正逐漸被削弱。
dialogue.ja: 世界的な人口爆発と都市の拡大、都市化の進展により、人間と自然、つまり私たちの食物の源との深い関係が弱まっています。
dialogue.local: With the worldwide population explosion and the expansion of cities and increasing urbanisation, the deep relationship between humans and nature, the source of our food, is weakening.
dialogue.en: With the worldwide population explosion and the expansion of cities and increasing urbanisation, the deep relationship between humans and nature, the source of our food, is weakening.

dialogue.text: Not everyone has the chance to be like me here, to experience how to cultivate rice and paddy fields, how to actually produce food.
dialogue.zh: 並非每個人都有機會像我一樣，在這裡體驗如何種植稻米和水田，如何實際生產食物。
dialogue.ja: 誰もが私のようにここで米や田んぼの栽培、食物の生産を体験できるわけではありません。
dialogue.local: Not everyone has the chance to be like me here, to experience how to cultivate rice and paddy fields, how to actually produce food.
dialogue.en: Not everyone has the chance to be like me here, to experience how to cultivate rice and paddy fields, how to actually produce food.

dialogue.text: The Chinese have always paid great attention to the beginning of summer since ancient times.
dialogue.zh: 中國自古以來一直非常重視夏季的開始。
dialogue.ja: 中国人は古くから夏の始まりを非常に重視してきました。
dialogue.local: The Chinese have always paid great attention to the beginning of summer since ancient times.
dialogue.en: The Chinese have always paid great attention to the beginning of summer since ancient times.

dialogue.text: More seedlings transplanted in the summer means more grains stocked up in the storehouses for winter.
dialogue.zh: 夏季移植的稻苗越多，冬天儲藏的糧食就越多。
dialogue.ja: 夏に多くの苗を移植することは、冬に備えて多くの穀物を蓄えることを意味します。
dialogue.local: More seedlings transplanted in the summer means more grains stocked up in the storehouses for winter.
dialogue.en: More seedlings transplanted in the summer means more grains stocked up in the storehouses for winter.

dialogue.text: This is a well-known common-seeing among Chinese farmers.
dialogue.zh: 這是中國農民中廣為人知的共識。
dialogue.ja: これは中国の農民の間でよく知られている常識です。
dialogue.local: This is a well-known common belief among Chinese farmers.
dialogue.en: This is a well-known common belief among Chinese farmers.

dialogue.text: Rice isn't only grown in the south of China, it's also grown up in the northeast, but in the northeast you've got very large flat areas where they use big machines to produce huge amounts of rice.
dialogue.zh: 稻米不僅在中國南方種植，也在東北種植，但東北有非常大的平坦地區，使用大型機械生產大量稻米。
dialogue.ja: 米は中国の南だけでなく東北でも栽培されていますが、東北には広大な平地があり、大きな機械で大量の米を生産しています。
dialogue.local: Rice isn't only grown in the south of China, it's also grown in the northeast, where large flat areas allow the use of big machines to produce huge amounts of rice.
dialogue.en: Rice isn't only grown in the south of China, it's also grown in the northeast, where large flat areas allow the use of big machines to produce huge amounts of rice.

dialogue.text: Down here in the south, and it's two seasons up in the north, they just do it once in the summer, but here they do it twice, and this is the first one.
dialogue.zh: 在南方這裡，北方有兩個季節，他們只在夏天種一次，但這裡種兩次，這是第一次。
dialogue.ja: 南部では年に二回作りますが、北部では夏に一回だけです。これは南部の最初の作付けです。
dialogue.local: Down here in the south, they have two growing seasons, while in the north they only plant once in the summer. This is the first season here.
dialogue.en: Down here in the south, they have two growing seasons, while in the north they only plant once in the summer. This is the first season here.

dialogue.text: And here in the mountains there's much less land to work with, and also you can't use big machines.
dialogue.zh: 而在山區，耕地較少，也無法使用大型機械。
dialogue.ja: 山間部では耕作地が少なく、大きな機械も使えません。
dialogue.local: Here in the mountains, there is much less land to work with, and big machines cannot be used.
dialogue.en: Here in the mountains, there is much less land to work with, and big machines cannot be used.

dialogue.text: So really the farming techniques here haven't changed over hundreds of years, because as Huang Lasha was explaining to me, no matter how good the machine is, it's not going to work as you go up these mountains, so they carry on using cows and they carry on using the same equipment and the horses that they've used for hundreds of years.
dialogue.zh: 所以這裡的農耕技術幾百年來幾乎沒變，正如黃拉沙告訴我的，無論機械多好，在這些山區都無法使用，因此他們繼續使用牛和他們使用了數百年的設備與馬匹。
dialogue.ja: ここでの農業技術は何百年も変わっていません。黄拉沙さんによると、どんなに良い機械でもこの山では使えないので、牛や何百年も使われてきた道具や馬を使い続けています。
dialogue.local: Farming techniques here haven't changed for hundreds of years. As Huang Lasha explained, no matter how good machines are, they don't work in these mountains, so they keep using cows, traditional equipment, and horses.
dialogue.en: Farming techniques here haven't changed for hundreds of years. As Huang Lasha explained, no matter how good machines are, they don't work in these mountains, so they keep using cows, traditional equipment, and horses.

dialogue.text: But this is a very idyllic lifestyle, I mean I'm covered in mud and I've been bent over in the fields planting rice, but I have to say I couldn't be happier.
dialogue.zh: 但這是一種非常田園詩般的生活，我全身沾滿泥巴，彎腰在田裡插秧，但我必須說我非常快樂。
dialogue.ja: しかしこれは非常に牧歌的な生活です。泥だらけで田んぼにかがんで植えていましたが、とても幸せです。
dialogue.local: This is a very idyllic lifestyle. I'm covered in mud and bent over planting rice, but I couldn't be happier.
dialogue.en: This is a very idyllic lifestyle. I'm covered in mud and bent over planting rice, but I couldn't be happier.

dialogue.text: With plentiful rain and sunlight, farmer is lush with plant life, especially at the beginning of the summer, even the most inconspicuous of classes regarded as a treasure by the locals, and each has its own special use.
dialogue.zh: 雨水和陽光充足，農田植物茂盛，尤其是夏初，連最不起眼的植物都被當地人視為寶藏，每種植物都有其特殊用途。
dialogue.ja: 豊富な雨と日光で、特に夏の始まりには農地は植物で溢れています。地元の人々は目立たない植物も宝物と見なし、それぞれ特別な用途があります。
dialogue.local: With plentiful rain and sunlight, the farmland is lush with plant life, especially at the beginning of summer. Even the most inconspicuous plants are regarded as treasures by locals, each with special uses.
dialogue.en: With plentiful rain and sunlight, the farmland is lush with plant life, especially at the beginning of summer. Even the most inconspicuous plants are regarded as treasures by locals, each with special uses.

dialogue.text: In the mountains outside the farmer village, there are wild fruits grown, and the beginning of summer is the season when they come to maturity.
dialogue.zh: 農村外的山區生長著野生水果，夏初是它們成熟的季節。
dialogue.ja: 農村の外の山には野生の果物が育ち、夏の始まりに成熟します。
dialogue.local: In the mountains outside the farming village, wild fruits grow, and the beginning of summer is their season of maturity.
dialogue.en: In the mountains outside the farming village, wild fruits grow, and the beginning of summer is their season of maturity.

dialogue.text: The local people gather these fruits every year and brew them into a special wine, and Mr Huang Wen Huiz says this wine can give you a very long life.
dialogue.zh: 當地人每年採集這些水果釀成特別的酒，黃文輝先生說這酒能帶來長壽。
dialogue.ja: 地元の人々は毎年これらの果物を集めて特別な酒を醸造し、黄文輝さんはこの酒が長寿をもたらすと言います。
dialogue.local: Local people gather these fruits every year and brew them into special wine. Mr Huang Wen Huiz says this wine can give you a very long life.
dialogue.en: Local people gather these fruits every year and brew them into special wine. Mr Huang Wen Huiz says this wine can give you a very long life.

dialogue.text: The Chinese raspberry is a very vigorous plant, no matter what the climate, whether the land is fertile or barren, green or dry, this fruit can grow in life.
dialogue.zh: 中國覆盆子是一種非常旺盛的植物，無論氣候如何，土地肥沃或貧瘠，綠色或乾燥，這種果實都能生長。
dialogue.ja: 中国のラズベリーは非常に生命力の強い植物で、気候や土地の肥沃さに関係なく育ちます。
dialogue.local: The Chinese raspberry is a very vigorous plant; regardless of climate or soil fertility, this fruit can grow.
dialogue.en: The Chinese raspberry is a very vigorous plant; regardless of climate or soil fertility, this fruit can grow.

dialogue.text: The fruits are extremely delicate and difficult to preserve.
dialogue.zh: 這些果實非常脆弱且難以保存。
dialogue.ja: 果物は非常に繊細で保存が難しいです。
dialogue.local: The fruits are extremely delicate and difficult to preserve.
dialogue.en: The fruits are extremely delicate and difficult to preserve.

dialogue.text: The secret of preservation is that it must be done on the same day the fruits are collected, because they deteriorate so quickly.
dialogue.zh: 保存的秘訣是必須在採摘當天完成，因為果實很快就會變質。
dialogue.ja: 保存の秘訣は、収穫した当日に処理することです。果物はすぐに傷んでしまいます。
dialogue.local: The secret of preservation is that it must be done on the same day the fruits are collected, because they deteriorate quickly.
dialogue.en: The secret of preservation is that it must be done on the same day the fruits are collected, because they deteriorate quickly.

dialogue.text: Every year at the beginning of summer, the new raspberry wine is sealed until the next summer, when it is opened and enjoyed at the longevity banquet in farmer.
dialogue.zh: 每年夏初，新釀的覆盆子酒會封存直到下一年夏天，屆時在農村的長壽宴上開封享用。
dialogue.ja: 毎年夏の始まりに新しいラズベリー酒が封印され、翌年の夏に農村の長寿宴で開けて楽しまれます。
dialogue.local: Every year at the beginning of summer, the new raspberry wine is sealed until the next summer, when it is opened and enjoyed at the longevity banquet in the village.
dialogue.en: Every year at the beginning of summer, the new raspberry wine is sealed until the next summer, when it is opened and enjoyed at the longevity banquet in the village.

dialogue.text: The farmer longevity banquet is a special celebration of the beginning of summer.
dialogue.zh: 農村長壽宴是慶祝夏季開始的特別活動。
dialogue.ja: 農村の長寿宴は夏の始まりを祝う特別な行事です。
dialogue.local: The farmer longevity banquet is a special celebration of the beginning of summer.
dialogue.en: The farmer longevity banquet is a special celebration of the beginning of summer.

dialogue.text: After the rice planting, all the farmer villages will make their share of a hearty meal together to celebrate, and to wish the elderly good health and longevity.
dialogue.zh: 插秧後，所有農村會一起準備豐盛的餐點慶祝，並祝願長者健康長壽。
dialogue.ja: 田植えの後、すべての農村は一緒に豪華な食事を作り、祝福し、高齢者の健康と長寿を願います。
dialogue.local: After the rice planting, all the farming villages prepare a hearty meal together to celebrate and wish the elderly good health and longevity.
dialogue.en: After the rice planting, all the farming villages prepare a hearty meal together to celebrate and wish the elderly good health and longevity.

dialogue.text: This is something I've never seen before, usually when you have dumplings in China, the outside is a bread, it's wheat or it's corn, but this is doughful, so on the outside here is all tofu, and the inside is pork and coriander.
dialogue.zh: 這是我從未見過的，通常中國的餃子外皮是麵粉或玉米做的，但這裡的外皮是豆腐，內餡是豬肉和香菜。
dialogue.ja: これは初めて見ました。中国の餃子は普通、小麦粉やトウモロコシの皮ですが、これは豆腐の皮で、中身は豚肉とコリアンダーです。
dialogue.local: This is something I've never seen before. Usually, Chinese dumplings have a wheat or corn dough outside, but here the outside is tofu, and inside is pork and coriander.
dialogue.en: This is something I've never seen before. Usually, Chinese dumplings have a wheat or corn dough outside, but here the outside is tofu, and inside is pork and coriander.

dialogue.text: You make them into these beautiful little cakes, and then we slap them down here, what happens next is they're deep-fried, that sounds delicious, look at that, it's a meow!
dialogue.zh: 你把它們做成漂亮的小餅，然後拍打在這裡，接著炸熟，聽起來很好吃，看那個，像喵喵聲！
dialogue.ja: これらを美しい小さなケーキにして、ここで叩きつけます。次に揚げます。美味しそうですね。見てください、まるで猫の鳴き声のようです！
dialogue.local: You make them into beautiful little cakes, then slap them down here, and next they are deep-fried. That sounds delicious, look at that, it's a meow!
dialogue.en: You make them into beautiful little cakes, then slap them down here, and next they are deep-fried. That sounds delicious, look at that, it's a meow!

dialogue.text: The food is ready, the annual rice ceremony begins, they've been farming rice for generations in farmer, the staple food here is of course rice, but first it must be blessed in a rice ceremony.
dialogue.zh: 食物準備好了，年度稻米儀式開始，農民世代務農，這裡的主食當然是稻米，但首先必須在稻米儀式中祝福。
dialogue.ja: 食事の準備ができ、年に一度の米の儀式が始まります。農民は世代を超えて米を栽培しており、主食はもちろん米ですが、まずは米の儀式で祝福されます。
dialogue.local: The food is ready, the annual rice ceremony begins. Farmers have been farming rice for generations. The staple food here is rice, but first it must be blessed in a rice ceremony.
dialogue.en: The food is ready, the annual rice ceremony begins. Farmers have been farming rice for generations. The staple food here is rice, but first it must be blessed in a rice ceremony.

dialogue.text: Well, now that that ceremony is over, I have to say that I was very unaware of exactly what was happening, I certainly didn't understand what the Taoist priest was saying, but the ceremonies for what I can understand mean that once I've had my sticky rice blessed that it will bring good harvest and longevity, I'm going to live for a very long time.
dialogue.zh: 儀式結束後，我必須說我當時並不完全了解發生了什麼，也不懂道士說什麼，但我理解這些儀式意味著祝福我的糯米能帶來豐收和長壽，我會活很久。
dialogue.ja: 儀式が終わり、正直に言うと何が起こっているのかよく分かりませんでした。道教の司祭の言葉も理解できませんでしたが、儀式は私のもち米を祝福し、豊作と長寿をもたらすという意味だと理解しています。私は長生きするでしょう。
dialogue.local: Now that the ceremony is over, I must say I was unaware of exactly what was happening and didn't understand the Taoist priest, but I understand the ceremony means my sticky rice is blessed to bring good harvest and longevity. I will live a long time.
dialogue.en: Now that the ceremony is over, I must say I was unaware of exactly what was happening and didn't understand the Taoist priest, but I understand the ceremony means my sticky rice is blessed to bring good harvest and longevity. I will live a long time.

dialogue.text: After the rice ceremony, the blessed rice will be specially dyed into five colors, turning it into a more ceremonial food for the banquet, five colored rice.
dialogue.zh: 稻米儀式後，祝福過的米會被特別染成五色，成為宴會上的儀式食品，稱為五色飯。
dialogue.ja: 米の儀式の後、祝福された米は特別に五色に染められ、宴会のための儀式的な食べ物になります。これを五色米と呼びます。
dialogue.local: After the rice ceremony, the blessed rice is dyed into five colors, making it a ceremonial food for the banquet called five colored rice.
dialogue.en: After the rice ceremony, the blessed rice is dyed into five colors, making it a ceremonial food for the banquet called five colored rice.

dialogue.text: The rice is dyed with natural edible vegetable juices, this wouldn't all be used to crush the leaves and extract the juice, it's the same one that was invented during a Han dynasty over 2,000 years ago.
dialogue.zh: 米用天然可食用的蔬菜汁染色，這些汁液是用來壓榨葉子提取的，這種方法是兩千多年前漢朝發明的。
dialogue.ja: 米は天然の食用野菜の汁で染められます。葉を潰して汁を抽出する方法は2000年以上前の漢代に発明されました。
dialogue.local: The rice is dyed with natural edible vegetable juices extracted by crushing leaves, a method invented during the Han dynasty over 2,000 years ago.
dialogue.en: The rice is dyed with natural edible vegetable juices extracted by crushing leaves, a method invented during the Han dynasty over 2,000 years ago.

dialogue.text: Oh, look at that, the color is shining through, that's so fun!
dialogue.zh: 哦，看那顏色透出來了，真有趣！
dialogue.ja: ああ、見てください、色が透けて見えます。とても楽しいです！
dialogue.local: Oh, look at that, the color is shining through, that's so fun!
dialogue.en: Oh, look at that, the color is shining through, that's so fun!

dialogue.text: I can remember my mother telling me, you should eat a variety of colors and foods it will keep you healthy, now these five healthy colors are all here, they remind me of the colors of the Olympic rings, I think maybe the secrets of the Bama people's health and longevity is symbolized by these five colors from nature.
dialogue.zh: 我記得媽媽告訴我，應該吃多種顏色和食物，這樣才能保持健康，現在這五種健康的顏色都在這裡，讓我想起奧運五環的顏色，我想巴馬人健康長壽的秘密也許就象徵於這五種自然色彩。
dialogue.ja: 母が言っていたのを覚えています。色々な色や食べ物を食べると健康でいられると。今ここにある五つの健康的な色はオリンピックの五輪の色を思い出させます。バマの人々の健康と長寿の秘密は自然のこの五色に象徴されているのかもしれません。
dialogue.local: I remember my mother telling me to eat a variety of colors and foods to stay healthy. These five healthy colors here remind me of the Olympic rings. Maybe the secret to Bama people's health and longevity is symbolized by these five natural colors.
dialogue.en: I remember my mother telling me to eat a variety of colors and foods to stay healthy. These five healthy colors here remind me of the Olympic rings. Maybe the secret to Bama people's health and longevity is symbolized by these five natural colors.

dialogue.text: The five colored rice is cooked and the longevity banquet begins.
dialogue.zh: 五色飯煮熟後，長壽宴開始。
dialogue.ja: 五色米が炊き上がり、長寿宴が始まります。
dialogue.local: The five colored rice is cooked and the longevity banquet begins.
dialogue.en: The five colored rice is cooked and the longevity banquet begins.

dialogue.text: The celebration of the beginning of summer has come into a clip, this is a festival which celebrates good health, long life and most especially, the rice itself.
dialogue.zh: 夏季開始的慶祝活動進入高潮，這是一個慶祝健康、長壽，尤其是稻米本身的節日。
dialogue.ja: 夏の始まりの祝祭は盛り上がり、健康、長寿、そして特に米そのものを祝います。
dialogue.local: The celebration of the beginning of summer has reached a climax. This festival celebrates good health, long life, and especially rice itself.
dialogue.en: The celebration of the beginning of summer has reached a climax. This festival celebrates good health, long life, and especially rice itself.

dialogue.text: The Chinese have a very deep connection to rice, after all they discovered it and they invented ways to cultivate it, rice is essentially the fuel of China, planting farming and harvesting in harmony with nature, seasons and cycles, contraction and growth, new life born from the 24 solar terms are the crystallization of this ancient wisdom.
dialogue.zh: 中國人與稻米有著深厚的聯繫，畢竟是他們發現並發明了種植方法。稻米本質上是中國的燃料，種植、耕作和收穫與自然、季節和週期和諧共存，收縮與成長，新的生命從24節氣中誕生，這是古老智慧的結晶。
dialogue.ja: 中国人は米と深い繋がりがあります。彼らが発見し、栽培方法を発明しました。米は中国のエネルギー源であり、自然、季節、周期と調和して植え、育て、収穫します。24節気から新しい命が生まれ、これは古代の知恵の結晶です。
dialogue.local: The Chinese have a deep connection to rice; they discovered it and invented cultivation methods. Rice is essentially the fuel of China, planted, farmed, and harvested in harmony with nature, seasons, and cycles. The 24 solar terms embody this ancient wisdom.
dialogue.en: The Chinese have a deep connection to rice; they discovered it and invented cultivation methods. Rice is essentially the fuel of China, planted, farmed, and harvested in harmony with nature, seasons, and cycles. The 24 solar terms embody this ancient wisdom.
